source: Gilmer et al., Neural Message Passing for Quantum Chemistry
primary_claim: MPNNs learn message passing and aggregation procedures over graph inputs
limitation: aggregation/update framework does not provide FTS semantic levels, absence or provenance

primary_claim: Permutation-invariant set functions have rho(sum phi(x)) form under stated conditions
limitation: sum does not supply Dist, memory, residual or hardware update law

source: Veličković et al., Graph Attention Networks
primary_claim: Masked self-attention computes weighted neighbor aggregation for graph representations
limitation: attention weights are not automatically evidence, provenance or refusal

source: Carandini and Heeger, Normalization as a canonical neural computation
primary_claim: Divisive normalization divides individual drive by a summed pool and can support invariance, competition and selection
limitation: review-level synthesis; exact implementation varies across circuits

source: Coultrip, Granger and Lynch, A cortical model of winner-take-all competition via lateral inhibition
primary_claim: Excitatory/inhibitory circuit can implement WTA through threshold and lateral inhibition
limitation: WTA may create hysteresis and requires regime conditions

source: Mao and Massaquoi, Dynamics of winner-take-all competition in recurrent neural networks with lateral inhibition
primary_claim: Lateral inhibition sharpens competing outputs and can create WTA equilibria
limitation: stability and multiple equilibria depend on activation/inhibition parameters

source: Rao and Ballard, Predictive coding in the visual cortex
primary_claim: Top-down predictions and bottom-up residual errors form a hierarchical recurrent computation
limitation: visual model; does not define FTS order or memory semantics

source: Friston et al., Neural Elements for Predictive Coding
primary_claim: Predictive/error/precision units form a multi-level architecture with recurrent and feedback interactions
limitation: neural mapping and learning rule remain model-dependent

source: Davies et al., Programming Spiking Neural Networks on Intel's Loihi
primary_claim: Loihi supports programmable on-chip learning for spiking neural networks
limitation: Loihi is a substrate, not evidence for FTS semantics

source: Merolla et al., A million spiking-neuron integrated circuit with a scalable communication network and interface
primary_claim: TrueNorth maps neurons, synapses, local memory and spike packets onto a manycore mesh
limitation: nonplastic synapses and fixed chip design limit learning transfer

source: Furber et al., A fully integrated reprogrammable memristor-CMOS system
primary_claim: Integrated memristive system supports on-chip vector-matrix operations and learning-related algorithms
limitation: device variability, precision and update nonlinearity remain constraints
